description: This source file defines the class MySQL57Platform, which extends Doctrine's MySQL57Platform class, and overrides the hasNativeJsonType method to return false. It is part of the OrangeHRM project and appears to customize database platform behavior for MySQL 5.7.

classes.name: MySQL57Platform
classes.description: A custom database platform class extending Doctrine's MySQL57Platform, overriding the hasNativeJsonType method to specify JSON support behavior.

methods.name: hasNativeJsonType
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to indicate whether native JSON type is supported; returns false.
